# S2b synthetic RINEX fixtures

`s2b_observations.rnx` and `s2b_navigation.rnx` are invented by
`research.kinematic.reference_fixture.fixture_texts`. They contain no acquired
RF data or real satellite orbit. GPS labels identify four synthetic references.
G08 contains deliberately nonnumeric payloads that must be discarded before
decoding. The observation file includes a predecessor and one excluded future
epoch; its 14 GPS observation types require a header continuation.

The independent generator uses circular inertial trajectories, a scalar
light-cone root and a five-point code derivative. The calibration uses parsed
broadcast GPS records and the separate receiver-time reference model.
Code/rate values are rounded to RINEX F14.3; phase values are used only for LLI.

Fixture bytes are preserved by `.gitattributes`; receipt hashes and full
scope are documented in `../../S2B_REFERENCE_BRIDGE.md` and the S2b report.
These are software/development fixtures, not unexposed RF confirmation data.

`s2_phase_observations.rnx` is a separate fixture generated by
`research.kinematic.phase_bridge_study.phase_fixture_texts`. It retains S2b
code/phase values, replaces every Doppler declaration with blank optional
GPS fields and retains the header continuation. With `s2b_navigation.rnx`
it validates the new code-to-clock-to-unused-phase bridge. Here numerical
phases ARE used as interval increments; the old S2b fixture/use is unchanged.
